name: windows-defender-pua-on
title: Block potentially unwanted apps (Defender PUA)
description: Turns on Defender blocking of potentially unwanted apps (Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled): adware, bundlers and browser hijackers that pass a normal scan. Refuses when Group Policy sets it.
manualUndo: Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection to the value before (Disabled or AuditMode)
measure: if (-not $s) { Add-ArhBlocker 'Microsoft Defender is not available on this computer'; Set-ArhPlan $false 'Nothing to do'; exit 0 }
if ($mode -and $mode -ne 'Normal') { Add-ArhBlocker "Defender is in ${mode}: another antivirus is in charge" }
if ($cur -eq 1) { Set-ArhPlan $false 'Already blocking' } else { Set-ArhPlan $true 'Turn blocking on' }
